packageRules.description: First-party shared workflows stay on the floating @v1 major tag by design (see shared-actions README, Versioning); SHA-pinning them would turn every shared-actions patch release into a PR here.

Pin ansible-core below 2.22: 2.22+ requires Python >= 3.13, but the target Ubuntu 24.04 ships Python 3.12 (pipx installs ansible-core/ansible-lint against it). Keep to the 2.21.x line, the last with Python 3.12 support.
Skip 2.21.0 — VariableLayer circular import bug breaks playbook execution; propose 2.21.1+ when available
Auto-merge non-major updates (bug fixes, backwards-compatible features, pins, digests) once CI passes. Major/breaking updates always stay on manual review.
